#### Calculations Tab

The Calculations tab displays the meter characteristics as read-only. These fields are datetime effective and can be edited within the Volume Editor. The current or most recent values are displayed for all fields.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="General">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />General Sub-Tab</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="General">

The following items are available on this sub-tab:

- **Pressure Base, Temperature Base, Heating Value Base Condition, Calculation Method and Z Method** - Read-only, datetime effective fields retrieved from the meter’s characteristics. These data points are initially configured during setup or are updated during meter import; they can be edited within the Volume Editor.

- **Heating Value Base Condition** - Read-only, datetime effective field retrieved from the meter’s analysis. This is initially configured during setup or updated during a meter import; it can be edited within the Volume Editor.

- **Ignore Bogus Pulses** - Setting this field to “Yes” has the following implications:

  - It is assumed that the data for this kind of meter uses the AGA-7 calculation.
  - The data set may be incomplete or invalid, preventing FLOWCAL from performing a full recalculation of volume and energy.
    <div class="example">

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Bogus Pulses">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

    <div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Bogus Pulses">

    Invalid data set:

    Pulses = 0, Volume = 5

    Pulses = 5, Volume = 0

    Incomplete data set:

    K-factor is missing

    </div>

    </div>
  - When the user edits and/or manipulates this kind of data set, FLOWCAL will only re-calculate energy if possible and/or applicable.
  - Some validation checks are bypassed to prevent an overwhelming number of exceptions.
    <div class="example">

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Validation Checks">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

    If the volume is zero, but pulses are non-zero, exception 1043 (CV - Pulses \> 0 but no volume) would normally be generated. However, by setting the Ignore Bogus Pulses option to "Yes", the exception will not be generated.

    </div>

  This flag is automatically set to "Yes" if the import driver is Mercury1 or Mercury2.

- <span id="CreatePPAs"></span>**Create PPAs** - These meter-level options determine which methods can be used to generate prior period adjustments through edits performed on closed data sets from a source other than manual edits within the Volume Editor. These options work in conjunction with the PPA options on the [System Configuration Approvals tab](../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Configuration/System%20Configuration%20-%20Approvals%20Tab.md).
  - When PPA options are set to “Apply Immediate”, the Allow Auto PPAs option must be checked to enable the use of the Create PPAs option in the Meter Editor.
  - When PPA options are set to “Approval Required”, the Allow Auto PPAs option is automatically set to "Yes" and the Create PPAs option in the Meter Editor must be checked to allow PPAs to be created for the meter.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 602;height: 561;" />

</div>

<span id="Quality"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Quality">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Quality Sub-Tab</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Quality">

This sub-tab contains configuration options for the Relative Density, Heating Value, Mass Heating Value, Mole %, Mass % and GPMs fields.

Configuration options are:

- **No Action** - Null values or imported data will remain as-is.
- **Fill In** - Null values will be populated with FLOWCAL-calculated values based on the analysis sample. Previously calculated values that were propagated from the prior meter analysis record will be replaced with FLOWCAL-calculated values based on the current analysis sample.

<!-- -->

- **Replace** - Imported values will be replaced with FLOWCAL-calculated values based on the analysis sample.

The C6+ and C7+ splits are used when performing hydrocarbon calculations such as density, heating value, mass heating value and others based on the analysis sample.

These options only apply when importing and editing data.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 605;height: 561;" />

</div>

</div>
